gold_note: Early dinosaur summary tree. Dinosauria, Ornithischia, Saurischia, Theropoda and Sauropodomorpha, joined by arrows to red node dots, are kept as internal labels. Two dots sit on a vertical shared with the node below: Ornithischia's dot is where the (Pisanosaurus, other Ornithischia) line leaves the Dinosauria vertical, below Silesaurus, and Theropoda's where Neotheropoda leaves, above the entering stem; each dot is read as its own node, so (Silesaurus, (Pisanosaurus, other Ornithischia)) and (Guaibasaurus, Neotheropoda) are clades. Fully resolved. 12 tips, fully resolved; 5 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
